zh.title: 卡達航空首架星鏈波音787-9客機投入營運
zh.summary: 卡達航空營運首架星鏈波音787-9客機；廣體機隊改裝進度已突破八成三
body: 卡達航空（Qatar Airways）已正式投入營運全球首架裝備星鏈（Starlink）衛星網路系統的波音787-9客機。此項里程碑標誌著該航空公司在拓展機上高速Wi-Fi服務方面取得新進展，先前該公司已在七個月內完成了波音787-8子機隊的星鏈網路改裝工程。
隨著首架波音787-9改裝完成，卡達航空旗下配備星鏈衛星網路的廣體客機總數已達到150架。這家總部位於杜哈的航空公司表示，目前整體改裝進度正常，預計將按原定計畫於2026年底前，完成旗下所有波音787全機隊的星鏈網路配備安裝。
此次波音787-9的投入營運，延續了卡達航空先前高效推進的機隊升級計畫。該航空公司此前已分別在九個月內完成波音777機隊的星鏈系統改裝，並在八個月內完成空中巴士A350機隊的升級作業。卡達航空指出，隨著這些改裝項目相繼完成，公司目前營運著全球規模最大且首創的星鏈配備波音777、空中巴士A350及波音787機隊。
自2024年10月在機上推出星鏈網路服務以來，卡達航空統計已有超過2,300萬名旅客在超過86,000個航班上使用該項連線服務。目前該公司的廣體機隊星鏈計畫改裝完成率已突破83%，每日營運高達323個配備星鏈網路的航班，為乘客提供免費且高速的機上衛星連線體驗。
除了持續推動全機隊的硬體改裝，卡達航空所配備的星鏈衛星網路提供高達500 Mbps的連線速度，讓乘客能在飛行途中順暢進行串流影音與網路通訊。乘客可透過該航空公司的優享會（Privilege Club）會員身分認證免費使用此項機上網路服務，惟部分機場的門到門連線權限仍須視當地監管法規而定。

en.title: Qatar Airways Begins Operating World's First Starlink-Equipped Boeing 787-9
en.summary: Qatar Airways introduces its first Starlink-equipped Boeing 787-9 as widebody fleet installations surpass 83 percent.
body: Qatar Airways has officially entered into service the world's first Boeing 787-9 aircraft equipped with Starlink satellite internet connectivity. The milestone represents the latest phase of the Doha-based carrier's fleet-wide inflight Wi-Fi expansion, following the completion of Starlink installations across its Boeing 787-8 sub-fleet within a seven-month period.

With the addition of the newly equipped Boeing 787-9, Qatar Airways has brought its total number of Starlink-equipped widebody aircraft to 150. The carrier stated that it remains on track to complete Starlink installations across its entire Boeing 787 fleet by the end of 2026.

The deployment of the Boeing 787-9 follows a series of rapid installation programs across the airline's widebody aircraft operations. Qatar Airways previously completed its Starlink rollout on its Boeing 777 fleet in nine months, as well as its Airbus A350 fleet in eight months. The airline noted that these completed rollouts give it what it describes as the world's first and largest Starlink-equipped fleets of Boeing 777, Airbus A350, and Boeing 787 aircraft.

Since launching onboard Starlink connectivity in October 2024, Qatar Airways reported that more than 23 million passengers have connected to the satellite internet service across over 86,000 flights. The airline's Starlink program has now surpassed an 83% completion rate across its widebody fleet, with up to 323 Starlink-equipped flights currently operating each day.

In addition to expanding installation across its aircraft, Qatar Airways offers Starlink Wi-Fi speeds of up to 500 Mbps, enabling passengers to stream content, work, and communicate during flights. Passengers access the complimentary gate-to-gate satellite internet service through the airline's Privilege Club membership authentication process, subject to local regulatory requirements at specific airports.
